title: Sometimes `_physics_process` and `_process` are skipped when the main window focus toggles
body:
### Tested versions

master branch at 42224bb750176560c515a875e50a1a25d5949ddb - Reproducible
4.4.1 - Reproducible
4.3.0 - Reproducible
4.2.1 - Reproducible


### System information

Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 15 Aug 2025 16:04:43 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 6900 XT (radeonsi, navi21, LLVM 20.1.8, DRM 3.64, 6.16.1-arch1-1) - AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.68 GiB memory

### Issue description

Running a project while toggling the window focus on and off seems to force the engine to skip `_physics_process` calls. Sometimes input events from `Input.parse_input` are also not processed. I'm not entirely sure what's happening here.

In the MRP, the `AnimationPlayer` will play an animation that calls `replay_input_events` with a set of inputs to be replayed at certain points in the animation.

If the window focus is not toggled on and off repeatedly, the animation plays successfully:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/83f83d8f-8384-49e1-9d3b-b15d2d475627

However, if one where to keep switching between the running project window and the Editor, the input replay does not work as expected at all:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d29e131b-bbab-440b-88ba-bf931876e525

Sometimes just switching windows once will change the final result. And the issue persist even when `input_devices/buffering/agile_event_flushing` is turned on.

### Steps to reproduce

* Run the MRP. Do not press WASD -- use only the mouse.
* As the MRP is running, focus the Editor and the running project window, back and forth. The final position of the sprite should be quite off -- the test should fail.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[PhysicsProcessSkipTester.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21847017/PhysicsProcessSkipTester.zip)
